description: Semantic search over 24M+ biomedical journal abstracts (more than 20 million of them in PubMed). Finds papers by MEANING, not keywords. Returns papers ranked by a hybrid relevance score (semantic similarity + lexical overlap + citation quality + recency) with abstracts, PMIDs, metadata and DOI links. Supports filters: year range, open access, citations, article type, journal, language, author name, DOI, PMID, and title search.

author.description: Filter by author name, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive: a surname ("Doudna") or a name as papers print it ("Jennifer A. Doudna"). Semantic search alone cannot find papers by author name; this metadata filter enables it.

doi.description: Exact DOI lookup (e.g. "10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00105"), in any case, with or without https://doi.org/.

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

journal.description: Journal name, matched as whole words in the journal field, case-insensitive ("Nature" also finds Nature Medicine) (optional)

offset.description: Skip this many ranked results to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 200 (optional)

pmid.description: PubMed ID lookup (e.g. "42130315"). Uses the btree index — instant.

query.description: The research question or topic to search for. Full abstracts / grant aims are supported (up to 2,000 characters) — e.g. "alpha-synuclein aggregation in Parkinson disease".

studyType.description: Only papers that PubMed classes as any of these study types (papers with a PubMed ID). "clinical trial" includes randomized controlled trials and "review" includes systematic reviews (optional)

titleSearch.description: Words of the paper title, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive. Use when you know part of the paper title.

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

type.description: Article type filter (optional). Nearly every paper in the corpus has type "article", so this filter rarely narrows a search. To find reviews, trials or other study types, use studyType.

yearFrom.description: Only papers from this year onwards (optional)

yearTo.description: Only papers up to this year (optional)

name: search_corpus
title: Search papers by meaning
